affected_party: QIF users, maintainers, reviewers, and AI agents applying QIF before implementation
actual_problem: QIF guidance currently emphasizes representation, traceability, and post-implementation validation more than pre-implementation prevention of mistaken quality hypotheses.
why_it_matters: Teams can pass structural verification while still implementing solution-biased UI, confused data boundaries, or acceptance criteria that lack negative conditions.
why_now: A cross-project retrospective showed that existing QIF concepts could have prevented a flawed blank/sample project design if used as a pre-implementation gate.
